notes.title: Version 0.2964: Update Macabre
notes.content:
Version 0.2964
--Added a splash screen before main title screen appears.
--Added a Pause feature. Press Start or F1.
--Augmented battle seguences. The unnecessary message log now no longer displays during battles, and a more summarized description of events is displayed instead. Also, dialogue displayed during battles 
has been optimized for clarity and timing.
--Improved save/load screens. Characters' faces now displayed, along with a picture of your save location and many details regarding your save file.
--Game Over screens now have a Continue or Return to Title option, instead of automatically returning you to the title screen.
--Fixed the item description for Crunch Cubes, which was cut off abrubtly.
--Improved event timing and facial expressions during Temple of Kalika event sequence.
--Removed the ability to save on three later maps which were supposed to be save-disabled.
--Optimized BGM at Capua Castle.
--Optimized choreography during opening sequence.
--PC Scrall's housecat will no longer block you from leaving the house.

notes.title: Volvalis Is Impending-New Title Screen Update!
notes.content:
Seven days from now you will die. Unfortunately. It's very likely anyway, hopefully most of you have a hearty constitution for torture and suspense. It will be present in [i]Volvalis[/i], by DaveighSoft, in abundance. You will get your fix of puzzles and intrigue, and as launch day looms the updates keep piling up.

The title screen and company branding have been updated, last minute detailing applied, and all seances performed. All signs are pointing to a successful launch, so it's okay to get your hopes up.

Say your prayers, and turn out the light, because it's almost time to turn on Volvalis....
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42343891/c7072c881a4d8399dd51dd761875587301c4cd7b.png[/img]
